speaker: consultant
text: Good morning, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Morning. Ben Carter here. I need to ask about moving my session on Thursday.

speaker: consultant
text: Hi Ben. Sure, what is the problem?

speaker: customer
text: A big client meeting came up on Thursday morning. Can we move our session to next week?

speaker: consultant
text: We can move it. Because Thursday is less than forty-eight hours away, there is a fee of fifty percent of the session fee.

speaker: customer
text: Fifty percent? For moving a meeting? That is ridiculous.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand it is annoying. The rule is in the agreement, because I usually cannot fill a slot at such short notice.

speaker: customer
text: I have been a client for five months. I thought that would count for something.

speaker: consultant
text: I value you as a client, Ben. I apply the same rule to everyone, so it stays fair.

speaker: customer
text: Fine. So what are my options exactly?

speaker: consultant
text: You can keep Thursday at ten, or move it and pay the fee. The other option is to do a shorter session by phone on Thursday afternoon.

speaker: consultant
text: Forty-five minutes, at four o'clock. That would not count as a reschedule.

speaker: customer
text: Let me check my calendar first. I'll let you know which option by tomorrow.

speaker: consultant
text: That is fine. Please tell me before noon tomorrow.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. I still think the rule is too strict.

speaker: consultant
text: I hear you, Ben. I will wait for your message.
